def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    line=[r for r in range(h) if any(x!=0 for x in g[r])]
    lr=line[0]
    L=h-lr
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for c in range(w):
        if g[lr][c]!=1 and g[lr][c]!=0:
            v=g[lr][c]
            for r in range(lr-L,lr):
                out[r][c]=1
            out[lr-L][c]=v
    return out
